settings.question: How do bundle discounts work?
settings.answer: Add 2 or more pairs and 20% comes off automatically in your cart. Add the shark blanket with any slippers and the blanket is 25% off. No codes.

settings.question: Can I mix sizes and styles in a bundle?
settings.answer: Yes. Any two or more pairs count — Winter or Originals, any size, any colour. The discount applies to every pair in your cart, and the blanket discount applies as soon as there is at least one pair with it.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: Orders are prepared within 3–5 business days, then delivered by standard courier (3–5 days, $3 — free over $30) or express courier (1–2 days, $6).

settings.question: Can I exchange or return?
settings.answer: All sales are final, but if your order arrives damaged or defective, message us on WhatsApp within 7 days and we'll replace it.
